digest.component_or_area: LLM model configuration and deprecation registry
propositions: REBAR_LLM_MODEL is a deprecated single-scalar environment variable that is superseded by per-class model configuration (REBAR_LLM_FRONTIER_MODEL, REBAR_LLM_UPSTREAM_MODEL, REBAR_LLM_REVIEWER_MODEL)

During the deprecation migration window, REBAR_LLM_MODEL continues to work, maps to all three model classes, and emits a warn_deprecated signal registered in _deprecations.REGISTRY via _scheduled with remove_in=_MAJOR

The deprecation warning must be emitted at every environment read of REBAR_LLM_MODEL (config.py:469 and a new read in model_classes.py) with no dedup, and must not be placed in resolve_model_string where provenance is lost

Operator-visible references to REBAR_LLM_MODEL as the current model-selection interface in help text, tool descriptions, module docstrings, and documentation must be updated to present per-class configuration instead
